description: Devices that read RFID/NFC tags. A reader emits tagDetected with the raw code. The RFID experience is the external authority and updates authorizedUsername/authorizedDisplayName/authorizedTagHash to reflect the current accepted identity. authorizedTagHash contains a hash, never the raw code. After deciding, the experience invokes tagAccepted or tagRejected to drive reader feedback (e.g. LED/beep).
